records.title: Cell transport: follow the energy
records.subject: physiology
objectives: Identify the driving force and membrane pathway for a specified neutral solute or ion.
Distinguish channel flow, facilitated diffusion, primary active transport and secondary active transport by energy coupling.
Trace the separate apical and basolateral steps of a simplified absorptive epithelial pathway.
Predict water and solute movement with explicit permeability and pressure assumptions.
